intro: Nahum announces the fall of Nineveh, capital of Assyria, the cruel empire that had crushed so many nations.
Chapter one describes the power of God, who is slow to anger, and a stronghold in the day of trouble. Chapters two and three picture Nineveh's fall.
Little is known of Nahum, whose name means comfort.
Listen for comfort to the oppressed: the LORD is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble.

card.parts: Ch. 1: the power of God | Ch. 2–3: Nineveh falls
